reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by SigNoz/components (https://github.com/SigNoz/components).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: About 只有一句 SigNoz Component Library，README 的小节是 Install & Use / Storybook / Available Packages / Contributing。文件树里除 .github、packages、apps/docs 之外，还有 BUILD.md、COMPONENT_GUIDELINES.md、COMPONENT_AUDIT_RUBRIC.md、VISUAL_TESTING.md；近期提交里有 docs(contributing): add clear docs on how to contribute 和 chore(tailwind-biome): remove tailwind and biome。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
